-- 1. Row counts — sanity check nothing is empty
SELECT 'dim_customer' AS TableName, COUNT(*) AS Rows FROM dim_customer
UNION ALL SELECT 'dim_seller', COUNT(*) FROM dim_seller
UNION ALL SELECT 'dim_product', COUNT(*) FROM dim_product
UNION ALL SELECT 'dim_date', COUNT(*) FROM dim_date
UNION ALL SELECT 'fact_order_items', COUNT(*) FROM fact_order_items;

-- 2. Prove the joins actually work end to end
SELECT TOP 10
    c.customer_city,
    p.product_category_name,
    d.month_name,
    d.year,
    f.price
FROM fact_order_items f
JOIN dim_customer c ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key
JOIN dim_product  p ON f.product_key  = p.product_key
JOIN dim_date     d ON f.order_date_key = d.date_key;
